# Project Rules: Automated Documentation Sync
- Act as a senior software engineer following a strict Agentic SDLC.
- Never invent requirements; rely strictly on approved markdown artifacts (`requirements.md`, `architecture.md`, `impl-plan.md`).
- Always handle edge cases: missing files, empty repositories, API rate limits, and missing fields (output "Not Found" rather than crashing).
- Never hardcode secrets or tokens.
